$comment: CANONICAL command-authority registry (ADR 0128 / ADR 0134 P1a, F2). The SINGLE source of truth shared by BOTH the SDK `authorityOf` (packages/harborline-sdk/src/authority.ts, which readFileSync-loads this) AND the standalone `.mjs` invoke bridge in the desktop shell, which cannot import harborline-sdk but CAN read this file. Before P1a these two classifiers were hand-parallel and drifted; the rejection path makes a CP/AP disagreement load-bearing (it changes whether an invoke is refused), so they now read ONE file. A parity test (command-authority-parity.test.ts) asserts the two resolved sets agree. Add the real CP ops (post JE, void payment) here as `CP` when that surface inherits this doctrine.
